names: hydroxyl-terminated polylactide diol, CN110627985B source Mn 1000

synthesis_basis.source_route: one-step HMDI/soft-segment-diol/DMD melt polyaddition catalyzed by DBTDL
synthesis_basis.quoted_source_evidence: For every TPU, HMDI is 0.0105 mol and DMD plus oligomer diol total 0.01 mol, giving NCO/OH=1.05. All reactants were heated at 90 °C until melted, DBTDL was added, temperature was gradually raised to 140 °C, and the reaction was maintained for 2 h.
